invariants.rationale: If name is null, bar returns -1. Otherwise, the result is something else.
If name is not null, result is the sum of x and name.length() as per the method logic.
The only valid return values are -1 (for null names) or x + name.length() (for non-null names), covering all cases.
Since the only values returned are either -1 or x + name.length() (where name.length() >= 0), result cannot be less than -1.
The result is -1 if and only if name is null.
